theater: 龜州山谷與茶河、陀河之間

battle.name: 龜州大捷
battle.theater: 龜州山谷與茶河、陀河之間
battle.brief: 一〇一九年正月，高麗在龜州山谷給遼聖宗南征大軍下了一次伏擊：蕭排押、蕭屈烈、耶律八哥率遼軍攻興化後中伏，退到茶河、陀河之間再戰又潰，蕭排押棄軍而逃，餘眾遭追殺，第三次高麗契丹戰爭以高麗全勝告終。卡面的希臘火不在這個半島戰場上，當年燒過的是火矢、猛火油櫃與火炬。

kit.name: 希臘火
kit.history: 配在銅管裡的燃燒劑。配方是帝國的機密，配方和船一起沉了。

countries: 這場戰爭是王氏高麗王國對遼朝的正面交鋒，也是雙方四分之一個世紀爭鬥的最後一役。高麗一方以中央軍制為骨幹：京師有「二軍六衛」的禁軍，地方各州縣設坊軍，另有編戶義軍與鄉兵，總兵力看着龐大，實則多數是放下農具的農兵，裝備與訓練參差不齊；對北方邊防的指揮權集中在樞密院與兵部，統軍將領多出自世代掌兵的家族，這次在龜州設伏的姜邯贊、姜民瞻便出自這條線。遼一方是聖宗耶律隆緒主持的帝國，軍權分北面官與南面官兩套，兵馬隸屬東西南北四京與諸路，蕃漢將領並行，遠征高麗的十萬大軍由東平王蕭排押任都統、蕭屈烈任副都統、耶律八哥任都監，國舅詳穩蕭敵烈、樞密使蕭合卓、东京留守耶律團石等人各領一翼。兩國結怨的表面理由是六個州的歸屬：興州、鐵州、龍州一線在渤海國亡國之後歸入高麗，遼卻一直要求歸還，而高麗寧可向宋稱臣，也不肯把這幾個州交出來。
countriesEn: This war was a direct confrontation between the Kingdom of Goryeo and the Liao dynasty, and it was the last round of a quarter-century of enmity between them. On the Goryeo side the backbone was the central military system: the capital carried the palace guards known as the two armies and six guards, while the provincial prefectures and counties maintained their own town militia, with household levies and village troops making up numbers that looked enormous but were in truth mostly farmers with uneven training and equipment. Command over the northern frontier rested with the Privy Council and the Ministry of War, and the commanders who served there usually came from families that had held military posts for generations; the men who set the ambush at Gwiju, Jiang Hanzan and Jiang Minzhan, belonged to exactly that line. The Liao side was the empire of Emperor Shengzong, Yelü Longxu, whose military authority was split between the northern and southern administrations, with troops enrolled in the four capitals and the various circuits and with both Khitan and Han commanders in the ranks. The invasion army of a hundred thousand was led by Prince Dongping Xiao Paiya as supreme commander, Xiao Qulie as his deputy and Yelü Bage as inspector of the camp, with the imperial uncle Xiao Dilie, the Privy Councilor Xiao Hezhuo, the commissioner of the Eastern Capital Yelü Tuanshi and others each commanding a wing. The stated quarrel between the two states was the ownership of six prefectures: the line of Xingzhou, Tiezhou and Longzhou had passed to Goryeo after the fall of the kingdom of Balhae, and the Liao had demanded their return ever since, while Goryeo would rather pay court to the Song than hand over those prefectures.
people: 遼聖宗耶律隆緒是整場戰爭的推手。他即位之後一直想恢復燕雲故地，屢次逼高麗交還六州，一〇一二年高麗顯宗王詢稱病不朝，一〇一三年遼派耶律資忠前往索取被拒、使節被扣，聖宗自此把外交爭執升級成兵事：一〇一四年命蕭敵烈先在鴨綠江造浮橋，耶律世良、蕭屈烈攻通州、寧州失手；一〇一六年劉晟、蕭屈烈在郭州以西得手，斬首萬餘、繳獲輜重；一〇一七年蕭合卓、王繼忠攻興化，遇上高麗的堅一、洪光，又敗而退。一〇一八年他改派東平王蕭排押為都統、蕭屈烈副之、耶律八哥任都監攻興化，蕭排押在谷中中伏，棄軍而逃，回軍潰散，這是他晚年最大的一次失手。高麗一邊在龜州作戰的是姜邯贊、姜民瞻與金宗鉉：兩位姜氏將軍預先在山谷布好伏兵，等遼軍深入便斷其首尾，再一路追到茶河、陀河之間，把殘軍包在兩水之中消滅。真正決定勝負的不是人數而是地形與節奏——遼軍連年遠征、糧道拉得太長，高麗只在本土作戰；把一支遠來的騎兵大軍引進預設的山谷再切斷退路，比在平地上硬碰省力得多。
peopleEn: Emperor Shengzong of the Liao, Yelü Longxu, was the man behind the whole war. Ever since his accession he had wanted to recover the old lands of Yan and Yun, and he pressed Goryeo again and again to hand back the six prefectures. In 1012 King Xuanzong of Goryeo, Wang Xun, feigned illness and stayed away from court; in 1013 the Liao sent Yelü Zizhong to demand them and the envoy was detained, and from that point Shengzong turned a diplomatic quarrel into a military one. In 1014 he had Xiao Dilie build a pontoon bridge over the Yalu River first, and Yelü Shiliang with Xiao Qulie attacked Tongzhou and Ningzhou without success. In 1016 Liu Sheng and Xiao Qulie won a battle west of Guozhou, cutting off more than ten thousand heads and taking the enemy baggage. In 1017 Xiao Hezhuo and Wang Jizhong struck at Xinghua, met the Goryeo commanders Jian Yi and Hong Guang, and again withdrew beaten. In 1018 he changed the command: Prince Dongping Xiao Paiya became supreme commander, with Xiao Qulie as deputy and Yelü Bage as camp inspector, and the army moved on Xinghua. Trapped in the valley, Xiao Paiya abandoned his army and fled and the survivors scattered; that was the worst defeat of Shengzong's late years. On the Goryeo side the men who fought at Gwiju were Jiang Hanzan, Jiang Minzhan and Jin Zongxian: the two Jiangs spread an ambush in the valley beforehand, waited for the Liao column to march deep inside, cut it in two, and then pursued the broken troops down to the waters of the Cha and the Duo, where the survivors were enclosed between the two rivers and destroyed. What actually decided the outcome was not the numbers of men but the ground and the tempo. The Liao army was on its third campaign in a row with a supply line stretched far behind it, while Goryeo fought at home; luring a distant cavalry army into a prepared valley and then closing its retreat cost far less than a frontal clash in the open.
kits: 卡面上的希臘火是拜占庭帝國的招牌裝備：相傳七世紀末君士坦丁堡的工匠卡利尼科斯試成了這種灌在銅管、用虹吸管推出的燃燒劑，最初用在帝國與阿拉伯人爭奪地中海的戰役裡，敘利亞、埃及沿岸的戰船與攻城戰都留下過它的痕跡，配方是帝國最高機密，配方隨戰船一起沉入海底。龜州是半島內陸的山谷追擊戰，希臘火並不在現場，這一點必須說清楚；與它同時、可以對照的是東方的同類技術：唐人杜佑《通典》與李筌《太白陰經》把猛火油櫃、火矢、火牛、發火飛石列為當時最完整的燃燒與爆破手段，明代《武備志》更把猛火油與西方傳來的希臘火並列，視為同一類東西。真正出現在龜州一線的器械要樸素得多：高麗與遼的步卒穿皮甲、札甲，用角弓配長骨箭，步軍持長標槊與木盾，騎兵配小圜盾，陣前靠旗幟、號角與軍鼓傳號，設伏時用柴草覆土臨時壘成寨柵，把山谷一段塞成一條狹道；糧秣上，遼軍靠驢馬馱運粟、麥與乾糧，從鴨綠江邊一路運到戰場，高麗則靠州縣義倉與就近徵發，兩軍都靠火把、火矢與燒毀輜重來斷對手的補給。
kitsEn: The Greek fire on the card is the signature equipment of the Byzantine Empire. According to tradition it was worked out in the late seventh century by a craftsman of Constantinople named Kallinikos, who filled it into bronze tubes and drove it out with a siphon; it was first used in the empire's struggle with the Arabs for the Mediterranean, and it left its mark in the fighting at sea and in the sieges along the Syrian and Egyptian coasts. The formula was the empire's highest secret, and the formula went down with the ships. Gwiju was a pursuit fought in an inland valley on the peninsula, and Greek fire was not present there; that has to be said plainly. What can be set beside it are the Eastern equivalents of the same period: Du You's Tongdian and Li Quan’s Taibai Yin Jing list the naphtha siphon-cart, fire arrows, fire oxen and incendiary stones as the fullest set of burning and breaching devices of the age, and the Ming military encyclopaedia Wubei Zhi actually groups the eastern naphtha together with the Greek fire that reached China from the west as one and the same kind of thing. The equipment that actually showed up on the Gwiju line was far plainer. The foot soldiers of both Goryeo and the Liao wore leather and lamellar armour, shot with composite bows and long bone arrows, and the infantry carried long spears and wooden shields while the horsemen used small round shields. Orders passed down the line on flags, horns and drums, and for the ambush the troops piled brushwood and earth into hasty stockades, wedging one narrow section of the valley shut. On the supply side the Liao carried grain, millet and dried rations on mules and horses all the way from the Yalu bridgehead, while Goryeo drew on the granaries of the prefectures and on requisitions close at hand; and both sides used torches, fire arrows and the burning of baggage to cut the enemy's supply line.
tactics: 高麗這一手是典型的以地制兵：先不接戰，把主力藏進興化通往內陸的山道兩側，等遼軍前鋒越過狹窄谷口再落鎖兩翼，切斷首尾聯繫；遼軍被迫後退時，再以騎兵與步卒混合的追擊部隊咬住不放，把戰場從山谷推到開闊的河谷地帶——茶河與陀河之間，水流限制退路，士卒爭渡，自相踐踏，遼軍才真正崩潰。蕭排押的座帳與旗鼓被丟在谷裡，成建制的部隊當場瓦解，餘眾各自逃回鴨綠江一線，糧隊與輜重全數丟在山峽中。遼軍的戰術本身並不差：都統、副都統、都監三層指揮，大軍集中攻一處，兩翼配騎兵迂迴，後方以浮橋連接鴨綠江的基地補給；問題出在連年用兵、敵情不熟、糧道太長，一支深入山谷的縱隊一旦被黏住，前面的援兵只能隔著山看。追擊階段雙方都動用火：夜裡以火炬照亮路面，以火矢射帳幕，以火把投擲燒毀糧車，趁亂再插旗幟鼓勵士氣，節奏全靠鼓點與號角。整場戰役的高潮不是正面交鋒，而是一次成功的伏擊加一次追殲。
tacticsEn: The Goryeo method was the classic one of using the ground to beat a bigger army. They did not engage at first: the main force was hidden on both sides of the mountain track leading inland from Xinghua, and only when the Liao vanguard had passed through the narrow defile did the two wings fall on it and cut the column in two. When the Liao were forced back, Goryeo cavalry and infantry mixed in the pursuit, kept the pressure on, and carried the fighting out of the mountains into the open river country between the Cha and the Duo, where the water hemmed in the retreat, the soldiers crowded at the fords and trampled one another; only then did the Liao army really come apart. Xiao Paiya's tent and command drums were left in the valley, the formations dissolved on the spot, and the survivors scattered back towards the Yalu, abandoning the baggage trains and the supply carts in the ravines. The Liao way of war was not bad in itself. Command ran in three layers through the supreme commander, the deputy and the camp inspector; the mass of the army was thrown at a single point with cavalry wings turning the flanks, and the rear was supplied from a base on the Yalu across the pontoon bridge. The trouble lay in fighting year after year, in not knowing the country, and in a supply line stretched to breaking point: once a column that had gone deep into a valley was held there, the reinforcements further up the track could only watch across the mountains. Both sides used fire during the pursuit: torches to light the road at night, fire arrows against the tents, lit brands thrown onto the baggage carts, and flags planted in the confusion to steady the men, with the whole rhythm carried by drums and horns. The climax of the battle was not a frontal clash but a successful ambush followed by an annihilating pursuit.
data: 關於兵力，高麗方面的數字向來被後世斥為誇大：韓國百科辭典的《龜州大捷》條目記高麗軍二十八萬、遼軍十萬、遼軍損失九萬以上，中文維基百科《第三次高麗契丹戰爭》的數據欄沿用這組數字；《遼史》一系的記載則遠為節省，兩邊的落差本身就是判讀的難處。二十八萬這個數字大概把州縣義軍與後勤雜役一併算進去了，實際列陣能戰的步卒只是其中一部分；十萬則接近遼軍傾國出動的極限，聖宗抽空東面兵力西渡鴨綠江，準備一口吞下高麗。時間線上，衝突自一〇一二年王詢稱病不朝起算，一〇一三年耶律資忠被拒、一〇一四年蕭敵烈造浮橋、一〇一六年在郭州以西得手、一〇一七年攻興化受挫，最後一〇一八年末至一〇一九年正月在龜州分出勝負；第三次高麗契丹戰爭打了六年，跨三次大規模交鋒，牽動的人馬以十萬計。至於龜州的地望，歷來有不同說法，一般指今慶尚南道一帶、靠近昌原與蔚山之間的洛東江下游，也有說法指更北面的地界；本篇採用爭議較小的說法，經緯度只取概略值。
dataEn: As for the numbers of troops, the Goryeo figures have long been dismissed as exaggerated. The Korean encyclopaedia entry on the Gwiju Great Victory records 208,000 Goryeo troops against 100,000 Liao troops with more than 90,000 Liao dead, and the data column of the Chinese Wikipedia article on the third Goryeo-Liao war repeats that set of figures; the Liao History, by contrast, is far more reticent, and the gap between the two traditions is itself the difficulty of reading this battle. The 208,000 almost certainly folds the provincial levies and the logistics staff into the total, and only part of it could actually have been drawn up in battle order. The 100,000 is close to the limit of what the Liao could put in the field at once, with Shengzong stripping the eastern garrisons to cross the Yalu and swallow Goryeo in one stroke. On the chronology: the quarrel runs from 1012, when Wang Xun stayed away from court pretending illness; 1013, when Yelü Zizhong was refused and detained; 1014, when Xiao Dilie built the pontoon bridge; 1016, when the Liao won west of Guozhou; 1017, when the attack on Xinghua failed; and it was settled in the valley at Gwiju between the end of 1018 and the first month of 1019. The third Goryeo-Liao war ran six years and three major engagements, and the forces involved are counted in tens of thousands. As for where Gwiju was, the location has always been disputed: it is generally taken to be in present-day Gyeongsangnam-do, near the lower reaches of the Nakdong between Changwon and Ulsan, though other accounts put it further north. This account follows the less disputed reading, and the coordinates given are rough.
cause: 導火索是六州之爭。渤海國亡國之後，興州、鐵州、龍州一線歸入高麗，遼聖宗卻認定這是前朝留下的錯劃，執意要高麗歸還；高麗顯宗王詢不願在國力未盛時與遼正面衝突，兩邊在使節與稱臣的禮節上僵持不下。一〇一二年王詢稱病不朝，一〇一三年遼派耶律資忠赴高麗索取六州，資忠被扣，聖宗自此把外交爭執升級為軍事行動，一〇一四年便命國舅蕭敵烈在鴨綠江造浮橋，第一波兵馬就壓了過來。深層的原因在體質：遼是北方遊牧帝國，中原與東北的農耕地是它最想要的稅基與兵源，每一趟南征都在消耗契丹騎兵的戰力，而高麗正卡在鴨綠江這條邊界上，無路可退。對高麗內部而言，姜氏等掌兵家族主張先發制人，宰相與樞密院擔心長期消耗，最後的答案是讓遼軍深入再收網——這正是龜州山谷伏擊的由來。
causeEn: The trigger was the quarrel over six prefectures. After the fall of Balhae the line of Xingzhou, Tiezhou and Longzhou had passed to Goryeo, and the Liao emperor Shengzong held that this was a mis-drawn border left over from an earlier age and was determined to have it returned. King Xuanzong of Goryeo, Wang Xun, was unwilling to confront the Liao while his own state was still growing, and the two sides locked each other in a deadlock of envoys and precedence. In 1012 Wang Xun stayed away from court pretending illness; in 1013 the Liao sent Yelü Zizhong to demand the six prefectures and he was detained, and Shengzong from then on promoted a diplomatic grievance into a military one, ordering the imperial uncle Xiao Dilie to build a pontoon bridge over the Yalu in 1014 and pushing the first wave of troops across. The deeper cause lies in the nature of the two states. The Liao was a northern nomadic empire whose tax base and manpower lay in the farming lands of the central plain and the north-east, and every expedition south spent the fighting strength of its Khitan cavalry, while Goryeo sat squarely on the Yalu frontier with nowhere to give ground. Inside Goryeo the military families such as the Jiangs argued for striking first, while the chancellor and the Privy Council feared a war of attrition, and the answer finally chosen was to let the Liao army come deep and then close the net. That is the origin of the ambush in the valley at Gwiju.
impact: 這場大捷的直接後果，是遼聖宗晚年最大的挫敗：傾國出動的南征大軍全軍覆沒，遼在南線的野戰能力被打斷，此後再沒有大舉東征高麗，直到遼朝覆亡，鴨綠江一線的邊界維持原狀。高麗則保住了興州、鐵州、龍州等六州，也保住了王氏王朝的生存；姜氏一族在軍中的分量因此更重，樞密院與兵部主導的邊防體制在往後的年代裡定型。以長時段看，勝方也沒有餘裕：遼把重心轉回北方草原、西邊的西夏與東北的女真，高麗則要在往後的年代收拾南方的耽羅與新羅舊境，兩國在往後一個世紀裡維持表面和平、互相猜忌。放到東亞的格局裡看，這一戰維持了宋朝北方門戶高麗的安全，使宋的東北翼線不必同時應付遼與高麗兩個方向的壓力；對高麗自己的歷史記憶而言，龜州大捷是立國百年裡少數能單獨標榜的北方大勝，名字被寫進地名與傳說，一直流傳到王朝末期。
impactEn: The immediate consequence of the Gwiju victory was the worst blow of the Liao emperor's late years: an invasion army drawn from the whole empire was destroyed, the Liao's capacity for offensive war on its southern front was broken, and there was no further large-scale campaign against Goryeo until the dynasty fell, with the Yalu frontier staying where it was. Goryeo kept the six prefectures of Xingzhou, Tiezhou, Longzhou and the rest, and with them the survival of the Wang house; the weight of the Jiang families in the army grew, and the frontier system run by the Privy Council and the Ministry of War took its final shape in the decades that followed. Over the longer term the victor had no easy breathing room either: the Liao turned its attention back to the northern steppe, to Western Xia in the west and to the Jurchens in the north-east, while Goryeo still had to settle the matter of Tamna in the south and the old Silla lands in the decades ahead, and for a full century the two states kept a surface peace while distrusting each other. Placed in the wider East Asian picture, this battle preserved the security of Goryeo, the Song's northern gateway, and spared the Song's north-eastern flank from having to answer pressure from the Liao and from Goryeo at the same time. In Goryeo's own historical memory, the victory at Gwiju is one of the very few northern triumphs the state can claim in its first century, and its name was written into place-names and legend, surviving to the end of the dynasty.
result: 第三次高麗契丹戰爭的結局是高麗全勝：一〇一八年冬到一〇一九年正月，蕭排押部在龜州山谷中伏，退到茶河、陀河之間再戰時被高麗軍包抄殲滅，蕭排押拋下本部與輜重逃回，餘眾潰散，遼軍建制崩解；高麗乘勝追擊，把戰果一直推到鴨綠江畔才收兵。經此一役，遼聖宗放棄了收回六州的要求，也不再興兵東來，兩國之間自九百九十三年到一〇一九年、前後二十六年的高麗契丹大戰爭就此落幕，邊界退回鴨綠江，雙方恢復朝貢與使節往來。對高麗而言，這是立國百年裡少數能單獨標榜的北方大勝，姜邯贊、姜民瞻的伏擊被後世記作「龜州大捷」，成為高麗邊防記憶裡的一個地名；對遼而言，則是一場不能忘記的敗績，此後不再以大規模南征作為國策，直至西夏與女真在北方崛起，改變了整個東亞的格局。
resultEn: The third Goryeo-Liao war ended in a complete Goryeo victory. Between the winter of 1018 and the first month of 1019 Xiao Paiya's army was ambushed in the valley at Gwiju, and when it fell back and fought again between the Cha and the Duo it was enveloped and destroyed; Xiao Paiya threw down his own command and baggage and fled, the survivors scattered, and the Liao formation came apart. Goryeo pursued the broken enemy as far as the Yalu before halting. After this campaign Shengzong abandoned the demand for the return of the six prefectures and never raised a new army in the east. The Goryeo-Liao war that had run from 993 to 1019, twenty-six years in all, was thus brought to a close; the frontier fell back to the Yalu and the two states resumed tribute and diplomatic missions. For Goryeo this was one of the very few northern triumphs it could claim in its first century, and the ambush by Jiang Hanzan and Jiang Minzhan came down to later generations as the Gwiju Great Victory, a place-name fixed in the frontier memory of the kingdom. For the Liao it was a defeat that could not be forgotten, and large-scale southern campaigns ceased to be a policy of the empire until the rise of Western Xia and the Jurchens in the north reshaped the balance of all East Asia.
